_about: Player achievements for Owner and Career Mode (a separate Dynasty card has none). Every achievement is DERIVED from numbers the game already keeps (career statistics, honours, the injury history, years with a club); nothing here is stored in a save, so adding or retuning one never touches saved data. Each has three tiers (1 bronze, 2 silver, 3 gold) that are reached when the named metric reaches the tier's threshold. Names are generic basketball words, not league trademarks. metric is one of the names FcAchievements.metrics_for computes.

achievements.name: Career scorer
achievements.description: Points scored in the regular season over a career.

achievements.name: Big scoring season
achievements.unit: points per game in a season
achievements.description: The best points-per-game average in one season.

achievements.name: Big rebounding season
achievements.unit: rebounds per game in a season
achievements.description: The best rebounds-per-game average in one season.

achievements.name: Big passing season
achievements.unit: assists per game in a season
achievements.description: The best assists-per-game average in one season.

achievements.name: One-club player
achievements.unit: seasons in a row with one club
achievements.description: Seasons in a row with the current club.

achievements.name: Scoring crown
achievements.description: Seasons as the league's top scorer.

achievements.name: All-League
achievements.description: Selections to the first all-league team.

achievements.name: Comeback
achievements.description: A serious injury (60 or more games) followed by a season of at least 40 games.
